description: After the user has chosen (from tc_suggest_functions) which functions to use, swap the matching steps of an already-saved test case for a call to each chosen function. Use this when the user saved from the recorder window; if the recording is not saved yet, pass the choice to tc_save instead. `functionIds` = the user's picks; omit for all matches. The replaced steps' own testdata is dropped and the function's default iterations are used. ONLY call after the user said yes.

functionIds.description: Function ids to apply (from tc_suggest_functions). Omit = all matches.

replace.description: Explicit picks: replace exactly these seqs with these functions, skipping the matcher. Takes precedence over functionIds. This is the "use FN-12 for steps 3-6" path.

stepSeqs.description: The `seq`s of the test case steps to swap for this function — use this when the user names the function AND the range. Must be contiguous.

tcId.description: Saved test case id or business key.

versionId.description: Version to edit (an id from the TC versions[]). Omit for the current version.

name: tc_replace_with_functions
title: Replace steps of a SAVED test case with existing functions
